top_signals.headline: Bank Indonesia Holds BI-Rate at 5.75% to Support Rupiah Stability
top_signals.impact: The central bank maintained its benchmark rate amid global uncertainty, balancing growth support with currency stability. Foreign reserves remain robust at $151.8B, providing FX intervention capacity.

top_signals.headline: JCI Index Resilient Above 7,200 as Foreign Flows Turn Positive
top_signals.impact: Jakarta Composite Index maintains strength driven by banking and consumer sectors. Net foreign buying resumed as EM sentiment improves on Fed pivot expectations. YTD performance +2.3%.

top_signals.headline: Indonesia Q3 GDP Grows 5.12% YoY, Beats Consensus Estimates
top_signals.impact: Economic expansion driven by household consumption (+4.9%) and fixed investment (+5.1%). Manufacturing PMI at 52.3 signals continued expansion. Full-year growth projected at 5.05-5.15%.

top_signals.headline: Federal Reserve Signals Potential December Rate Cut Amid Cooling Inflation
top_signals.impact: FOMC minutes suggest committee members see conditions for further easing. Core PCE trending toward 2.5% target. Markets pricing 65% probability of 25bp cut in December.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Rupiah Stabilizes at 15,850/USD on Trade Surplus
top_signals.impact: Currency finds support from continued trade surplus ($10.5B Q3) and BI intervention. Carry trade dynamics remain favorable vs USD. Key resistance at 16,000 level.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Banks Report Strong NIM Expansion in Q3 Results
top_signals.impact: Major banks (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI) posted 12-15% earnings growth with NIMs expanding to 5.2-5.8%. Loan growth accelerated to 11.5% YoY. NPL ratios stable at 2.1-2.4%.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 Approaches All-Time High on AI Optimism and Rate Cut Bets
top_signals.impact: Index trading near 6,000 level as tech sector leads. Magnificent 7 stocks contribute 60% of YTD gains. Earnings growth re-accelerating to +8% YoY in Q4.

top_signals.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls to 4.35% on Dovish Fed Outlook
top_signals.impact: Bond yields decline as markets reprice Fed trajectory. Real yields at +2.0% remain attractive for fixed income allocations. Duration positioning shifts to neutral.

top_signals.headline: Treasury yields nudge higher as investors monitor geopolitical uncertainty
top_signals.impact: U.S. Treasury yields inched higher on Thursday as geopolitical uncertainty dominated headlines.

top_signals.headline: China Manufacturing PMI Expands to 51.5, Supporting EM Sentiment
top_signals.impact: Factory activity strengthens on stimulus measures and export recovery. Positive read-through for Asian supply chains and commodity demand. EM currencies rally.

top_signals.headline: Brent Crude Holds at $78/bbl as OPEC+ Maintains Production Discipline
top_signals.impact: Oil prices stabilize on balanced supply-demand outlook. OPEC+ compliance remains high at 95%. Inventory levels normalize. Range-bound trading expected near term.

top_signals.headline: Goldman Sachs tops profit estimates as equities, asset and wealth management outperform
top_signals.impact: Goldman's revenue dipped 3% in Q4, which the company said was the result of offloading the Apple Card loan portfolio to JPMorgan Chase.

top_signals.headline: TSMC breaks big revenue milestone in thumping fourth quarter, raises guidance on revenue and AI capex for 2026
top_signals.impact: TSMC’s stock jumps 5% after announcing a stonking set of 4Q numbers that have positive implications the companies it supplies and those who supply it.

top_signals.headline: Wholesale inflation was softer than expected, retail sales moved higher in November
top_signals.impact: Wholesale prices moved up less than expected while consumers kept up a heavy buying pace, according to economic data Wednesday.

top_signals.headline: Pace of Inflation Held Steady in December; Consumer Prices Up 2.7% on Year
top_signals.impact: Latest market news.

top_signals.headline: Dow Jones Futures Fall Amid Wells Fargo, Citigroup, BofA Earnings; Tesla FSD To Be Subscription Only
top_signals.impact: Bank of America, Wells Fargo and Citigroup reported.

top_signals.headline: Mortgage refinance demand surges 40% higher after Trump post briefly tanks interest rates
top_signals.impact: Mortgage rates dropped markedly at the end of last week, causing a huge jump in demand to refinance and a smaller surge in demand from home buyers.

top_signals.headline: Stock futures lose ground as traders weigh more bank earnings: Live updates
top_signals.impact: Bank earnings got off to a rocky start. Investors continued to digest several demands made by President Donald Trump.

top_signals.headline: JPMorgan Chase tops estimates as trading revenue exceeds expectations
top_signals.impact: JPMorgan will give investors a view into how consumers and corporations fared toward the end of last year and issue guidance on how 2026 may develop.

top_signals.headline: Delta CEO sees record earnings in reach again thanks to high-end travel demand
top_signals.impact: The airline said bookings are strong from both leisure customers and corporate travelers in the first few days of the year.

top_signals.headline: How much one parent needs to earn so the other can stay home in every U.S. state
top_signals.impact: Many families want or need one parent to stay at home with a young child. While that may help save on child care, the single-earner still needs a decent income.

top_signals.headline: Goldman Sachs’s revenue fell for first time in 2 years — Apple Card was the problem
top_signals.impact: Goldman Sachs beat fourth-quarter profit expectations by a wide margin, amid particular strength in the investment banking and equities businesses, but the stock fell as revenue disappointed.

top_signals.headline: Under threat from Trump, Wall Street banks wager they can fend off credit card price controls
top_signals.impact: Five days after Trump's demand to cap credit card rates, bankers and lobbyists told CNBC they have yet to receive any formal or written guidance on the policy.

top_signals.headline: Billionaire Rams owner Stan Kroenke becomes America's biggest private landowner
top_signals.impact: Kroenke represents a growing wave of ultra-wealthy entrepreneurs investing in long-held ranches and farmland.

top_signals.headline: How Saks's acquisition of Neiman Marcus plunged the company into bankruptcy: 'Recipe for disaster'
top_signals.impact: Saks used $2.2 billion in junk bonds to buy Neiman Marcus, but didn't have enough money left over to pay vendors, which led the company to declare bankruptcy.
